Bratz - Girlz Really Rock.name: Bratz: Girlz Really Rock
Bratz - Girlz Really Rock.summary: This is your chance to be a superstar! Practice lead guitar, keyboard, or dance and rock out live on stage. Check out the Fashion Designer Suite to create wicked outfits, apply killer make-up and try out some fabulous hairstyles. Take five and catch some air skydiving, or hit the mini-golf course in single or multiplayer modes.

Death Jr. - Root of Evil.name: Death Jr: Root of Evil
Death Jr. - Root of Evil.summary: Death Jr. II: Root of Evil is a 2008 action-adventure game developed by Backbone Entertainment the sequel to the PlayStation Portable video game Death Jr. The game has various differences from the first, including having a second playable character, Pandora.

Disaster - Day of Crisis.name: Disaster: Day of Crisis
Disaster - Day of Crisis.summary: Disaster: Day of Crisis is a video game developed by Monolith Soft and published by Nintendo. It is an action-adventure survival game, where the player must survive through various natural disasters, all the while also battling terrorists and rescuing civilians. According to Nintendo, the game features "cutting-edge physics and gripping visuals" to re-create the sheer terror of major catastrophes.

Donkey Kong Jungle Beat.name: Donkey Kong Jungle Beat
Donkey Kong Jungle Beat.summary: The highly rated Nintendo GameCube game, created by the same team that developed Super Mario Galaxy, returns with enhanced motion controls and new surprises.
developers: Nintendo EAD Tokyo Software Development Group No.1

Heavy Fire - Afghanistan.name: Heavy Fire: Afghanistan
Heavy Fire - Afghanistan.summary: Heavy Fire: Afghanistan is a super fast playing on-rails shooter set in modern-day Afghanistan featuring tanks, assault vehicles and helicopters. The game offers 60 awards, one machine co-op for up to four, Steam Cloud, Leaderboards and Trading Cards.

Hidden Mysteries - Titanic.name: Hidden Mysteries: Titanic
Hidden Mysteries - Titanic.summary: Titanic: The Game takes place aboard the R.M.S. Titanic on her fateful maiden voyage across the Atlantic. The player’s avatar is a young socialite, Margaret Ashley, one of the fortunate unfortunates who sailed on Titanic and survived. Throughout the course of the game, Margaret is presented with sets of puzzles and obstacles that she must overcome to progress the timeline from April 10th - the date Titanic left Southampton Dock – to the 15th, when she sunk beneath the waves.

Safari Adventures - Africa.name: Safari Adventures: Africa
Safari Adventures - Africa.summary:
Help your friends save the animals!

Discover the various planet ecosystems and resolve the problems linked to environmental degredation. Make friends with over 50 animals, including elephants, cheetahs and more. Fill your photo album with pictures of all your latest explorations and new found friends. 90 amazing habitats to choose from and over 90 missions to solve!
